nodes.title: Explore product space
nodes.prompt: Independently map the meaningful product behaviors, authorities, and unknown decisions. Write durable findings in the repository.

nodes.title: Explore failure space
nodes.prompt: Independently search for omitted axes, destructive boundaries, concurrency, persistence, and recovery behaviors. Write durable findings in the repository.

nodes.title: Synthesize Behavior Atlas
nodes.prompt: Read every dependency artifact and repository finding. Produce one compact Behavior Atlas; mark unknowable product choices UNKNOWN rather than guessing.

nodes.title: Critique completeness
nodes.prompt: Try to falsify the synthesized Atlas. Check official registries, missing axes, missing crossings, ambiguous expectations, and exact observation fields.

nodes.title: Implement exact cases
nodes.prompt: Implement the frozen Atlas cases end to end. Every case must execute and compare the complete canonical observation by exact equality.

nodes.title: Audit closure
nodes.prompt: Independently prove Atlas IDs equal generated, executed, asserted, and exact-comparison IDs. Block on skips, partial matchers, stale digests, extras, or missing IDs.
